proposals.announcement_evidence: for all items under the classification of lumber, millwork and plywood for the Wood Products Tailored Logistics Support Program
proposals.rationale: The only index name with real lexical purchase on this record is IMRLS, and the overlap is the two-word phrase 'Logistics Support' inside a different program's title. The award is a four-way multiple-award IDIQ commodity vehicle for lumber, millwork and plywood under DLA Troop Support's Tailored Logistics Support acquisition program, bought with defense working capital funds; the Generic Logistics R&D Technology Demonstrations line funds an RDT&E project, not a supply vehicle for wood products. This is rejected by two of the rubric's section 3 patterns at once: generic logistics services with no named program, and a name that is an acquisition vehicle the contract runs under rather than the program element the PE funds. No other record in this chunk names any DLA lexicon program.
